text:
Maya: quick check before I cut the tag — are we set to publish the draft GitHub release after the annotated tag? I'll cut v1.14.0 in ~30m unless someone objects.
Sanjay: go ahead, just confirm artifacts are uploaded and checksum present.
Maya: artifacts pushed to CI bucket: s3://redwood-ci/release/v1.14.0/artifacts.tar.gz  sha256: 3f7a9d4b8c9e2f1b2a5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a
Assaf: cc @Maya @Sanjay — please include the changelog notes for the BETA features, I already updated CHANGELOG.md on release/bump-1.14 branch.
Maya: ok i'll squash the changelog commit into the tag. command i'll run:
```
 git checkout release/bump-1.14
 git pull --ff-only origin release/bump-1.14
 git tag -a v1.14.0 -m "release: v1.14.0"
 git push origin v1.14.0
```
Sanjay: reminder: create a Draft GitHub release (annotated tag text -> release body), attach linux/mac assets + checksums, then trigger the sign job.
ReleaseBot: CI: all checks passed on release/bump-1.14 (build 1945320888). Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.com/artifacts/1945320888 (sha256: 3f7a9d4b...)
Maya: who owns the signing key for CI releases? @Anna can you sign once draft exists?
Anna: I can sign. Ping me the Draft link after you create it and I'll run GPG sign + upload signed.tar.gz.
Assaf: also add a short rollback snippet in the release body: `git tag -d v1.14.0 && git push origin :refs/tags/v1.14.0` and a note about reverting the release branch.
Maya: plan: cut tag at 16:30 UTC, create draft GH release with the annotated changelog, attach assets, ping @Anna for signing, then publish. Any last-minute blockers?
Sanjay: infra looks clear. :thumbsup:
Anna: standing by. :white_check_mark:
Maya: thank you — cutting in ~20m and will post the draft link here when done.
